# SOP-MP-031 Foot pad replacement

Procedure: SOP-MP-031

Revision: C

## Work record

Work order: WO-QD-6107

Machine: QD-05

Performed on: 2026-05-19

Diagnosis: Foot pad cracked on leg RR

## Procedure

- Power the robot down and place it on the service stand
- Remove the two retaining screws from the foot pad on leg RR
- Fit the new foot pad and torque the screws to 2.5 N.m
- Power up and run the stance self-test

## Parts replaced

| Part | Removed | Installed |
|---|---|---|
| Foot pad RR | FP-0210 | FP-0305 |

Performed by: T. Nakamura
